name: Isometric Voxel Rendering
definition: An algorithm that renders a voxel model into an isometric projection by iterating over a 2D pixel grid and determining which voxels contribute to each pixel's visible surface, using a tiling system to draw triangles for exposed faces.
summary: Isometric Voxel Rendering is an object-order algorithm that projects voxel models into a fixed isometric view by explicitly calculating screen-space coordinates to draw triangles directly, differing from ray-marching by avoiding iterative sampling.
